title: Create: SBB Train Jingle
description: A small Texturepack replacing the Create Train Whistle with the SBB Jingle
body:
A small Texurepack replacing the Steam Whistle sound of Trains with the SBB Jingle. Does not modify the standard Create Steam Whistle for Music.

SBB Jingle Source: https://www.myinstants.com/de/instant/sbb-jingle-83441/

Made By DoktorCraft
